trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Cause:** Version v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate had also failed in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. It's now running in all three regions, and the error rate has dropped to about 0.2%. No approval was needed because v2.3.0 was healthy in production before.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is titled "checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0." It describes what failed, the rollback and the current health. It also says the cause of the v2.3.1 failure should be found before it's deployed again. My first attempt to create it timed out. I confirmed no incident had been created, then retried using a key that prevents duplicates, so only one incident exists.
